PROJECT DEMO

Jezero Go/No-Go

See how a 20-minute time cut changes the Marswalk.

Transcript

Can the crew reach Jezero’s ancient delta and make it back? At 150 minutes, the west fan fits with four minutes to spare. Mission Control cuts 20 minutes. The west fan is now 16 minutes over budget. Switch to the crater floor. The crew can still study a different geologic target and return with 41 minutes to spare.

Paths use USGS Mars 2020 MRO CTX elevation data. Rover imagery is from Perseverance Mastcam-Z. Walking speed and stop coordinates are simulation assumptions.

Video created with OpenAI Codex assistance. Mars data and photographs are credited in the simulator.
